uci_metadata.name: CDC Diabetes Health Indicators
uci_metadata.abstract: The Diabetes Health Indicators Dataset contains healthcare statistics and lifestyle survey information about people in general along with their diagnosis of diabetes. The 35 features consist of some demographics, lab test results, and answers to survey questions for each patient. The target variable for classification is whether a patient has diabetes, is pre-diabetic, or healthy.

HighBP.label: High Blood Pressure
HighBP.description: Diagnosed with high blood pressure by a doctor or health professional.

HighChol.label: High Cholesterol
HighChol.description: Ever told by a health professional that blood cholesterol is elevated.

CholCheck.label: Cholesterol Check (5 Yrs)
CholCheck.description: Had blood cholesterol screening within the past 5 years.

BMI.label: Body Mass Index (BMI)
BMI.description: Body Mass Index calculated from weight and height (kg/m²).

Smoker.label: History of Smoking
Smoker.description: Smoked at least 100 cigarettes (5 packs) in entire lifetime.

Stroke.label: History of Stroke
Stroke.description: Ever told patient had a cerebrovascular stroke.

HeartDiseaseorAttack.label: Heart Disease or Attack
HeartDiseaseorAttack.description: Coronary heart disease (CHD) or myocardial infarction (MI).

PhysActivity.label: Regular Physical Activity
PhysActivity.description: Physical activity or exercise during the past 30 days outside regular job.

Fruits.label: Daily Fruit Intake
Fruits.description: Consumes fruit 1 or more times per day.

Veggies.label: Daily Vegetable Intake
Veggies.description: Consumes vegetables 1 or more times per day.

HvyAlcoholConsump.label: Heavy Alcohol Consumption
HvyAlcoholConsump.description: Heavy drinking (adult men >=14 drinks/week, adult women >=7 drinks/week).

AnyHealthcare.label: Healthcare Coverage
AnyHealthcare.description: Has health insurance, HMO, or government healthcare coverage.

NoDocbcCost.label: Deferred Doctor Due to Cost
NoDocbcCost.description: Needed to see a doctor in past 12 months but could not due to cost.

MentHlth.label: Poor Mental Health Days
MentHlth.description: Days in past 30 days that mental health (stress, depression) was not good.

PhysHlth.label: Poor Physical Health Days
PhysHlth.description: Days in past 30 days that physical health (illness/injury) was not good.

DiffWalk.label: Difficulty Walking / Stairs
DiffWalk.description: Serious difficulty walking or climbing stairs.

Education.label: Education Level (1-6)
Education.description: Education scale 1-6 (4=High school grad, 5=Some college, 6=College graduate).

feature_stats.description: Self-reported general health (1=Excellent, 2=Very Good, 3=Good, 4=Fair, 5=Poor).
